violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (deli slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The deli slicer was cleaned and sanitized during the time of inspection and allowed to air dry prior to returning to service. Deli slicer cleaning guidance provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The establishment was observed reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) deli meats without prior approval by RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Food items were voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Establishment is to cease practice of placing deli meats into ROP packaging and submit application and processes for approval by RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Utensils (coffee equipment) were observed stored in sanitizer between uses. Utensils between uses shall be stored in one of the following manners: in water with sufficient flow to flush particulates to the drain, in water that is maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or more, or on a dry clean surface. Utensils were moved to a dry clean surface during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Salad mix was observed stored above the fill line of prep unit #2 and was held at 56 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food item was voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Proper storage methods discussed with PIC during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Various food items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/26/2025

The floor and walls in the stove area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2025
